title: Change the road cross-section
description: Widen the left half of the road and check the two sides independently in the cross-section.

setup.goal: Change one half-width and read both widths at a station.
audience: Forest road designers new to PGMaps
access: None: the lesson opens the synthetic training project, which needs no sign-in and no data download.
setup.startingScreen: The road designer on the Hillside access training project, at station 0+000 with the cross-section shown.
limitations: The readings are those of the synthetic training terrain and the Hillside access roads as shipped.

overlay.title: Open Section
overlay.body: Open the Section tab. Road cross-section holds the widths, crossfall, batters and ditch of the road.

overlay.title: Widen the left side
overlay.body: Change Left half-width (m) from 3 to 4. Leave Right half-width (m) at 3: each is measured from the road centreline.

context.label: the cross-section in the detail pane

overlay.title: Read both widths
overlay.body: At 0+000, Width L/R reads 4.0 / 3.0 in the cross-section: the left side is one metre wider, so the running width here is seven metres.
